260203.caption: I've prepared some snacks. Mashed potatoes with maple syrup, marshmallows with maple syrup... Hmm. They all look delicious!

260205.caption: When I'm not here, feel free to keep Maple Moon with you, Commander. Then I'll be able to serve you from afar.
